methodology: Seeded software-only validation; deterministic inputs/logical outcomes, variable measured host timings. No physical hardware or network I/O.

target_projection.basis: ABI model (not a complete target build)
target_projection.assumptions: AVR: 2-byte function pointers/alignment 1; ILP32: 4-byte pointers/alignment up to 4; float=4, bool=1. Inter-member class padding and transport/IP objects excluded.

target_projection.basis: ABI model (not a complete target build)
target_projection.assumptions: AVR: 2-byte function pointers/alignment 1; ILP32: 4-byte pointers/alignment up to 4; float=4, bool=1. Inter-member class padding and transport/IP objects excluded.

benchmark_1_memory_and_parser.buffer_note: Automatic function-local arrays, not static class members. Their sum is a component budget, not a measured simultaneous stack high-water mark.

micro_ros_reference.basis: User-requested illustrative 24 KiB reference; NOT a measured or universal micro-ROS minimum.

benchmark_2_hydra_sync_under_jitter.kind: seeded discrete-event simulation using real SwarmMaster and Linux SwarmNode methods
benchmark_2_hydra_sync_under_jitter.calibration: Three actual PING/STATE exchanges with symmetric 3 ms one-way delay; no assigned clock estimates.
benchmark_2_hydra_sync_under_jitter.scope: MCU names are roles, not physical processor emulators. Execution records software callbacks, not shaft movement. Poll periods are declared simulation assumptions; no OS/network sleeps or instruction timing.

benchmark_3_swarm_scaling.kind: host microbenchmark with a discrete-event network
benchmark_3_swarm_scaling.scope: Actual SDK dispatch/serialization and receive/drain/state-update paths; no OS UDP, sockets, threads, congestion or physical Wi-Fi. RX latency is host processing time, not network latency. CPU includes measurement-call overhead; service rate includes harness work and is not maximum wire capacity.

benchmark_4_safety_interlocks.kind: deterministic fault injection into the real Linux node implementation
benchmark_4_safety_interlocks.scope: Reordering trial re-inserts older packets after newer packets; 15% is relative to primary commands, not all delivered packets. Deadlock stops application sends while keepalives continue. No-lease stop time is right-censored, not proof of infinite energization. Logical callback stops do not establish physical stopping time or emergency-stop coverage on every driver.
